fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6TB6N: ship check's parseFailedTests reads only Go '--- FAIL:' lines, so nebari#72's RSpec failure ended the run at ci-triage. The planner asked which intent to serve, which runners to parse and how to name a non-Go failing test; the arbiter ruled (decision-ci-triage-runners): serve m27-nebari-on-rhiza; also parse RSpec 'rspec ./path:line', Rails Minitest '(bin/)rails test path:line' and pytest 'FAILED path::test' lines, nothing broader; name each by the runner's rerun command, Go names unchanged. No owner words: the owner did not take part.
fields.title: Planning ci-triage runner parsing, autonomous run with the arbiter
